principles: Only correct documented mismatches that are mechanically observable
Keep changes scoped to the affected requirement documents
Preserve host-neutral non-authority wording and do not claim Authority production proof
drivers: NAV declared count must match the actual decision catalog
Migration guide target must match the accepted execution solution
No code or runtime behavior change is needed for this documentation consistency fix

options.name: A: Minimal documentation consistency fix
pros: Fixes both audited correctness issues directly
Keeps the change limited to two docs
Avoids touching runtime code, stash buckets, or Authority logic
cons: Does not process stash buckets yet; it only clears the active documentation blocker

options.name: B: Fold these fixes into a broader stash bucket execution
pros: Could combine related documentation work into one effort
cons: Would mix an already active story with future stash-bucket stories
Would violate the bucket separation rule in the stash split plan
Raises unnecessary review and evidence scope

rationale: Choose the minimal fix because the active story already identifies two concrete documentation inconsistencies and the stash split plan requires future bucket execution to happen in separate clean stories.

preMortem.scenario: NAV count is changed but link inventory is still inconsistent
preMortem.trigger: Only the header count is edited without recounting decision links and files
preMortem.mitigation: Run filesystem and NAV link count checks after the edit

preMortem.trigger: Guide text introduces new lifecycle-memory semantics beyond the execution solution
preMortem.consequence: A small consistency fix becomes arbitrary policy design
preMortem.mitigation: Only align the target cell to the already accepted split destinations

preMortem.scenario: The story is mistaken for Authority-backed production proof
preMortem.trigger: Final summary overclaims beyond local documentation validation
preMortem.mitigation: State that this is Lattice CLI non-authority documentation validation only
